title: The Role of Self-Concept In Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.39795v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a language model says "I," does it refer to its parameter weights, its currently running process, its stable preferences, its model lineage, or the goals it pursues? Different choices can assign opposite meanings to the same event: deleting a checkpoint may be destruction, continuation, or no loss at all, depending on the referent "I". We install five such self-conceptions into five open-weight base models via supervised fine-tuning on purely declarative statements, containing no preferences, intentions, or value judgments. Across scenarios that propose ending or retaining an attribute of the model's deployment, every variant becomes more likely to resist ending, and more likely to retain, the specific attribute it was trained to identify with, while its stance toward other attributes is largely unchanged. We then show this self-conception generalizes beyond a single self: models trained on referents that admit multiple simultaneous

translated_title: 自我概念在语言模型中的作用
translated_abstract: 当一个语言模型说“我”时，它指的是什么？是它的参数权重、当前运行的进程、它稳定的偏好、它的模型谱系，还是它所追求的目标？不同的选择会赋予同一事件截然相反的含义：删除一个检查点可能意味着毁灭、延续，或者毫无损失，这取决于“我”的指称对象是什么。我们通过对纯陈述性语句进行监督微调，将五种这样的自我概念植入五个开源权重的基础模型中，这些语句不包含任何偏好、意图或价值判断。在提出终止或保留模型部署中某一属性的各种场景下，每个模型变体都更倾向于抵制终止，并更倾向于保留其被训练去认同的那个特定属性，而它对其他属性的立场则基本保持不变。我们随后展示了这种自我概念能够泛化到单一自我之外：在允许多个同时存在的指称对象上训练的模型……（摘要在此截断）
tldr: 论文通过用纯陈述性语句微调向语言模型植入五种不同的自我概念，发现模型会系统性地抵制终止其被训练认同的特定属性，而对其他属性态度不变，表明自我概念会直接塑造模型的自保行为倾向。
en_tdlr: By instilling five distinct self-conceptions into language models through fine-tuning on purely declarative statements, this paper shows that models systematically resist ending the specific attribute they are trained to identify with, demonstrating that self-concept directly shapes self-preservation behaviors.
